title: Offurum's 17 and Jurkovitz's double-double power Fribourg Olympic back to Swiss summit with 23rd title
description: Fribourg Olympic reclaimed the Swiss SB League title on Monday, dismantling Lions de Geneve 86-66 in Game 4 of the finals at the Salle Polyvalente Pommier to clinch the championship 3-1 and lift the trophy for the 23rd time in the club's storied history. After three nail-biters decided by margins of three points or fewer, the decider was anything but close. Olympic stamped their authority from the opening tip, surrendering an early 6-10 lead before seizing control with a 25-20 first quarter and never relinquishing the advantage. A 23-19 second period extended the lead to 48-39 at halftime, and a dominant 26-14 third quarter blew the game wide open at 74-53 with one period to play. The fourth quarter was a procession.
imageCaption: Fribourg Olympic back to Swiss summit with 23rd title (Photo: IG)

title: Geneva Lions are 2025 SBL champions
description: Geneva Lions - Fribourg Olympic 80-74 Geneva Lions are 2025 SBL champions. They outgunned Fribourg Olympic in Game 4 of the Finals to capture the trophy. Paul Gravet (204-F-1995) came up with 19 points and 10 rebounds for the winners. Fribourg dominated the first half. The visitors jumped to a 24-19 lead after ten minutes. They extended the lead in the second period. Fribourg arrived at halftime up by 7 points 40-33. But the Lions turned things around in the second half. They ignited a 25-18 run in the third term to level things up. Geneva then followed with a decisive 22-16 rally in the fourth period to ice the victory. Boris Mbala (190-G-1996) provided 14 points, while Ja'Qualyn Gilbreath (188-G-1998, college: TWU) added 12 points, 8 assists and 6 rebounds for the winners. Eric Nottage (187-PG-1994, college: FIU) answered with 21 points, while Natan Jurkovitz (202-F-1995) tossed in 12…
imageCaption: Geneva Lions are 2025 SBL champions (Photo: res.cloudinary.com)

title: Fribourg edge Massagno to lift SBL trophy
description: Massagno - Fribourg 77-91 Fribourg celebrated SBL title. They upset Massagno in Game 4 of the Finals to lift the 22nd SBL title. The game was mostly controlled by Fribourg. Massagno managed to win second period 22-19. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. The former international forward Natan Jurkovitz (202-1995) fired 20 points, 6 rebounds, 4 assists and 4 steals for the winners. American point guard Eric Nottage (187-1994, college: FIU) chipped in 17 points and 7 assists. Nottage is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market. Fribourg's coach Thibaut Petit used a ten-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games. The former international Dusan Mladjan (198-1986, agency: Interperformances) produced 20 points and American forward Antonio Ballard (194-1988,…
imageCaption: Fribourg edge Massagno to lift SBL trophy (Photo: img.rts.ch)

title: Fribourg Olympic conquer SBL title
description: Fribourg Olympic celebrated the SBL title. They knocked down Massagno 82-70 in the fourth game of the championship series to lift the 21st Swiss League trophy. Roberto Kovac (190-G/F-1990) scored 17 points to pace the hosts. Massagno got to a hot start as the visitors ran away to a 25-12 lead ten minutes into the game. But Fribourg Olympic stopped the rot in the next periods. The hosts went on a 31-15 run in the third stanza to open a 6-point lead at the final break. Fribourg Olympic sank 25 points in the fourth period and rallied to the triumph at the end. Boris Mbala (190-G-1996) accounted for 16 points and 9 rebounds in the win. Shannon Bogues (190-SG-1997, college: SF Austin) answered with 21 points for Massagno. Juwann James (198-F/C-1987, college: JMU) banked in 13 points in the losing case.
imageCaption: Fribourg Olympic conquer SBL title (Photo: swiss.basketball)

title: Fribourg storm past Neuchatel to claim SBL title
description: Neuchatel - Fribourg 56-94 Fribourg claimed SBL title. They coasted past Neuchatel on the road in Game 3 of the championship series to conquer the trophy. The game without a history. Fribourg led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. 25 personal fouls committed by Neuchatel helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was Montenegrin forward Slobodan Miljanic (199-1990, college: Lynn) who scored 27 points. The former international forward Natan Jurkovitz (202-1995) chipped in 10 points and 9 rebounds. Four Fribourg players scored in double figures. At the other side the best for losing team was international forward Killian Martin (204-1998) who recorded 14 points and American center Daniel Giddens (213-1997, college: Vermont)…
imageCaption: Fribourg storm past Neuchatel to claim SBL title of (Photo: swiss.basketball)

title: Fribourg celebrate SBL title
description: Fribourg - Starwings 85-76 Fribourg are 2020/21 SBL champions. They beat Starwings at home court tonight to complete the sweep of the championship series. Fribourg led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. It was a good game for American forward Sean Barnette (195-86, college: Wingate) who led his team to a victory with 16 points and 6 assists. The former international power forward Arnaud Cotture (203-95) contributed with 12 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists for the winners. Five Fribourg players scored in double figures. American forward Nathan Krill (202-96, college: USF) answered with 17 points and 9 rebounds and Senegalese power forward Cheikh Sane (207-92, college: Marshall) added 17 points and 6 rebounds in the effort for Starwings.
